title: The root rule roles-review-cap-three says a guard or check change is done at its fix check pass, as the merge tool and R9 already treat it
why: Owner ruling own-833-a-done-at-fix-check (page item 833, option a, 15:01 CST Nov 14, no note): rewrite the root clause in place. Today the root CLAUDE.md rule roles-review-cap-three still says "Only a guard or check change fixed under a fix verifier also waits for round 3"; R9 (owner 18:35 CST Nov 13) names that clause stale; the merge tool already reads a guard or check change that failed round 1 and passed its fix check as done (seen on #3399, 05:40 CST Nov 14). The rewrite makes the text say what the tool does: no round 3 after a fix check pass, round 3 only after a round 2 fail; the net-value test follows round 3 only. Rewrite superseded text in place, fewest words (rule speak-rewrite-superseded-in-place). The root CLAUDE.md exists in two copies that carry a lint (the repo's own and the global one in claude-settings main): the lane finds the one home and changes it, with decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 and pr-review-record checked for the same words. Home step: rounds-rules-one-record. Unmeasured: round 3 after a round 1 fail fixed under a fix check; the lane records the first sample it meets. First act of a lane: read the clause, the two decisions and the tool code that decides it, then change the text; a lint or test that names the clause moves with it, red then green. Round 1 review: a rule text change that moves what a round asks for. LANE STARTED 15:11 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:09): lane session_013NEJL11cEDaHwwwcz1qaQt.
